_: THE SWEEP THAT SAYS R1237's CONTRACT IS NOT VACUOUS — run it from the
WHAT THE CONTRACT IS. A step that waits on somebody else's server declares a
bound, and that bound is SMALLER THAN ITS JOB'S. On 2026-08-18 two jobs of
one run stalled in the same `apt-get` for 45m09s and ninety minutes; nothing
of this repository ran in either.
THE LAW IS ASSERTED AGAINST THE REAL WORKFLOWS, so an injection here edits
the workflow or the law itself rather than a fixture. Two break the SUBJECT
(a bound removed; a bound as large as the job it sits in) and two break the
POPULATION — which is the half that would otherwise rot in silence: the law
reads `undeclared-requirement`'s installer vocabulary and adds one word of
its own, and each of those halves can stop covering what it covers today.
RUN IT LOCALLY. The harness edits this tree and writes the firing record
beside this file (R1205's carry, and the `writes` line in the declaration).

injections.name: a-step-that-fetches-loses-its-bound
injections.why: the state every one of the sixteen was in before R1236 and R1237, and the state ten of them were STILL in after R1236 bounded six by hand. A step whose service stops answering then spends its job's entire budget, and every step behind it is skipped — measured, twice in one run

edits.to: run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y protobuf-compiler strace

injections.name: a-step-is-bounded-by-the-whole-of-its-jobs-budget
injections.why: the checkbox version of this law. `timeout-minutes` is filled in, a reader scanning the file sees a bound on every fetch, and nothing is prevented: the step can still spend the ninety minutes its job has. This is why the law compares the two numbers rather than asking whether one exists

injections.name: the-population-drops-back-to-this-laws-own-word
injections.why: the first draft of this law, and the reason it was rewritten. A population built on a word list alone stops covering whatever the list stops naming — here the six `apt-get` steps — while staying green, because a law that looks at less finds less. The containment assertion against `undeclared-requirement`'s own reading is what makes that red

injections.name: the-word-that-covers-the-rest-stops-matching
injections.why: the other half of the same rot, one letter wide. `rustup show` installs a toolchain and no named package, so the shared reading does not name those nine steps and only this word does. A typo here would take nine of sixteen out of the population with nothing to show for it — which is exactly N120's open shape, and why this law asserts the word still matches something
